Documentgeneratie, anonimisering, ondertekening en AVG/Woo-publicatie-instemming voor Nextcloud
info.description:
Document generation, anonymisation, signing, and GDPR/WOO publication consent for Nextcloud
DocuDesk generates documents from templates bound to Open Register fields, anonymises personal data (PII) in documents through a configurable entity-detection backend, signs outbound documents (eIDAS SES/AdES/QES), and tracks GDPR and Wet Open Overheid (Woo) publication consent — all processed locally on the customer's own Nextcloud instance. It integrates with Open Register via events to enrich documents as they are created and updated.
## Key Features
- Document generation from Twig/HTML templates, output as PDF, ODF (.odt), or HTML, with Open Register field binding - PII anonymisation, with entity detection routed through a configurable backend (regex, OpenAnonymiser, Presidio, or an LLM) via Open Register - Digital signing with eIDAS signature levels (SES, AdES, QES) and sequential or parallel multi-signer workflows - GDPR publication consent tracking with configurable objection periods (Wet Open Overheid, default 4-week objection period) - Document metadata enrichment: automatic language detection, keyword extraction, and topic classification - OCR text extraction (Tesseract) for scanned and image-based documents - Document comparison and document validation/quality checks - Folder- and dossier-level batch anonymisation with legal-basis (grondslagen) tracking under Woo Art. 5 - Event-driven integration with Open Register
**Requires:** [OpenRegister](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/openregister) (install from the [Nextcloud App Store](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/openregister)).
Requirements can be found [here](https://docudesk.conduction.nl)
The Roadmap is available [here](https://codeberg.org/Conduction/docudesk/milestones)
